propositions: Three pure filesystem primitives (_resolve_tracker_git_dir, _ticket_dirs, _dir_is_archived) are incorrectly located in fsck_repair.py despite having no repair-specific logic, causing seven production modules to depend on the repair module for unrelated functionality.
The primitives must be moved from fsck_repair.py to gitutil.py while maintaining gitutil as a stdlib-only leaf with no rebar module-level imports, preserving the acyclic dependency graph.
Module-level re-exports must be maintained in fsck_repair.py and fsck.py to preserve test compatibility, as three tests use monkeypatch.setattr to bind these names as fsck_repair module attributes.
Function-local importers (compact.py, bridge_repair.py, tracker_maintenance.py) must be repointed directly to gitutil rather than using compat re-exports to eliminate the inverted dependency.
After the move, gitutil.py must remain under 800 LOC (grows from 614 to ~665 LOC) and fsck_repair.py must also remain under 800 LOC (shrinks from 686 to ~640 LOC).
